caption:
Selling a home can take much longer than most people expect. Real estate is often an 'illiquid' asset, meaning you cannot convert it to cash quickly if your plans change. Before committing to a major purchase, ensure your money is aligned with your personal timeline and liquidity needs. Understanding these basics helps you avoid getting stuck in a tough spot. Context: Business Standard. What is one factor you consider before making a big purchase?
